description: This Java source file defines the UpsServices class, which provides methods for integrating with UPS shipping services within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for shipment confirmation and acceptance, constructs XML requests, handles responses, and manages UPS-related shipping data.

classes.name: UpsServices
classes.description: A utility class providing methods to communicate with UPS's shipment services, including shipment confirmation and acceptance, handling XML request/response, and updating shipment data accordingly.

classes.name: UpsServices
classes.description: A utility class providing methods to communicate with UPS's shipment services, including shipment confirmation and acceptance, handling XML request/response, and updating shipment data as needed.

methods.name: upsShipmentConfirm
methods.description: Constructs and sends a shipment confirmation request to UPS, processes the response, and updates shipment route segment details such as tracking ID, costs, and weights.

methods.name: handleUpsShipmentConfirmResponse
methods.description: Processes the XML response from UPS for a shipment confirmation, updates the shipment route segment with shipping costs, weights, tracking info, and handles errors.

methods.name: upsShipmentAccept
methods.description: Constructs and sends a shipment acceptance request to UPS, and updates the shipment route segment status upon success.

methods.name: handleUpsShipmentAcceptResponse
methods.description: Processes the XML response from UPS for a shipment acceptance, updates costs, weights, tracking info, and handles errors.

methods.name: upsVoidShipment
methods.description: Generates and sends a void shipment request to UPS, processes the response, and updates the shipment status accordingly.

methods.name: handleUpsVoidShipmentResponse
methods.description: Handles the response to a void shipment request, updating the shipment route segment status based on success or failure.

methods.name: upsTrackShipment
methods.description: Creates a tracking request to UPS, processes the response, and updates tracking information and status.

methods.name: handleUpsTrackShipmentResponse
methods.description: Processes the tracking response from UPS, updates shipment status, weights, and labels, and handles errors.

methods.name: upsRateInquire
methods.description: Performs a rate inquiry to UPS based on shipment details, parses the response, and returns rate estimates.

methods.name: handleUpsRateInquireResponse
methods.description: Processes rate estimate responses from UPS, extracting shipping rates and errors.

methods.name: createAccessRequestDocument
methods.description: Builds the XML document for UPS access credentials used in all requests.

methods.name: handleErrors
methods.description: Processes error elements in UPS responses, generating error messages and populating error lists.

methods.name: splitEstimatePackages
methods.description: Splits packages based on max weight and adds package elements to XML requests.

methods.name: addPackageElement (with packageMap)
methods.description: Adds package XML element with detailed product info and dimensions, considering default weight and splitting rules.

methods.name: addPackageElement (with packageWeight)
methods.description: Adds a simple package XML element with specified weight.

methods.name: checkForDefaultPackageWeight
methods.description: Ensures package weight is not below minimum threshold.
